what_it_does: Introduces X-MoE, a software framework for training large language models that use Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures across diverse hardware platforms. In MoE models like DeepSeek-MoE, different 'expert' neural networks specialize in different types of knowledge, and a router network decides which experts to activate for each input. Current training systems have trouble scaling these models due to massive memory overhead and expensive communication patterns, and they only work well on NVIDIA GPUs. X-MoE makes training efficient on various hardware by reducing redundant communication and using smarter memory management.
